name: 国保料に子ども・子育て支援分を新設
summary: 令和8年4月1日から、国民健康保険料に子ども・子育て支援納付金分が加わります。この区分の所得割率は0.27%、被保険者均等割額は1人1,800円、18歳以上被保険者均等割額は1人73円で、賦課限度額は3万円です。あわせて、ほかの保険料率や均等割額を改め、保険料が軽減される世帯の所得の基準を、被保険者1人あたり30万5,000円から31万円、56万円から57万円に引き上げます。
changes: 子ども・子育て支援納付金分を新設し、所得割率を0.27%、被保険者均等割額を1人1,800円、18歳以上被保険者均等割額を1人73円、賦課限度額を3万円とする
子ども・子育て支援納付金分の均等割額を、18歳に達した日以後の最初の3月31日までの人は全額減額し、所得の低い世帯や未就学児、出産する人も減額する
医療分の所得割率を7.71%から7.51%に、均等割額を47,300円から47,600円に改め、賦課限度額を66万円から67万円に引き上げる
後期高齢者支援金分の所得割率を2.69%から2.80%に、均等割額を16,800円から17,600円に改め、介護納付金分の所得割率を2.25%から2.43%に、均等割額を16,600円から17,800円に改める
who: 足立区の国民健康保険加入者
国民健康保険に加入する18歳未満の人

en.name: Adds a child and childcare support contribution to national health insurance premiums
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Adachi City National Health Insurance Ordinance
en.summary: Starting April 1, 2026, a child and childcare support contribution will be added to national health insurance premiums. For this contribution, the income-based rate will be 0.27%, the per-capita amount will be ¥1,800 per insured person, the per-capita amount for insured people aged 18 and over will be ¥73 per person, and the assessment limit will be ¥30,000. The ordinance will also revise other premium rates and per-capita amounts, and raise the income thresholds for households eligible for reduced premiums from ¥305,000 to ¥310,000 and from ¥560,000 to ¥570,000 per insured person.
changes: Add a child and childcare support contribution, with an income-based rate of 0.27%, a per-capita amount of ¥1,800 per insured person, a per-capita amount of ¥73 per insured person aged 18 and over, and an assessment limit of ¥30,000

Fully waive the child and childcare support contribution's per-capita amount for people through the first March 31 after the date they turn 18, and reduce it for low-income households, preschool children, and people giving birth
Revise the medical-care component's income-based rate from 7.71% to 7.51% and its per-capita amount from ¥47,300 to ¥47,600, and raise its assessment limit from ¥660,000 to ¥670,000

Revise the late-stage elderly support contribution component's income-based rate from 2.69% to 2.80% and its per-capita amount from ¥16,800 to ¥17,600; revise the long-term care contribution component's income-based rate from 2.25% to 2.43% and its per-capita amount from ¥16,600 to ¥17,800
who: Adachi City National Health Insurance enrollees
People under 18 enrolled in National Health Insurance
People who give birth while enrolled in National Health Insurance
en.why: The ward says this is to update the ordinance provisions, including in response to revisions to the Order for Enforcement of the National Health Insurance Act.
